counting_rule: Count distinct designed full views, app overlays and external step/panels separately. Filters, shared states and Stop Mode stage variants are not extra full pages. All are planned designs, not implemented native routes.

pages.name: Sign in
pages.purpose: Enter the approved courier account and understand access results.
pages.top: Small BagooPH identity, Sign in heading, short purpose.
blocks: Remember-email meaning separate from session persistence
pages.primary: Sign in: full-width after the fields; stays above the keyboard when needed.
pages.secondary: Forgot password under password; Apply as a rider below the main action.
pages.why: One red submit button makes the next action distinct; neutral outlined fields make editing recognizable. Recovery links use dark accent text rather than rival filled buttons.
pages.special_states: Bad credentials remain beside the correct field; expired session explains re-entry; unknown or wrong-role access does not open Tasks.
pages.dependency: Accepted sign-in and own-account contract; no browser-to-native session assumption.

pages.name: Application preparation
pages.purpose: Prepare the rider to complete the existing application without surprise uploads.
pages.top: Apply as a rider, Back and concise eligibility explanation.
blocks: Accepted format/size from the current policy
Three application stages and what happens after submission
pages.primary: Continue application: full-width lower action opens approved first-party entry.
pages.secondary: Already applied: Sign in; document help opens P33.
pages.why: An unboxed checklist reads as guidance, not completed verification; the red continuation identifies one path. Status claims are absent until a real submission is read.
pages.special_states: Missing requirements show unavailable guidance instead of fabricated limits; leaving keeps no document files in this page.
pages.dependency: First-party onboarding remains the recommended initial flow; this preparation view is an optional design addition.

pages.name: Application and placement status
pages.purpose: Explain review, correction, placement or access restrictions accurately.
pages.top: Account name, exact status, last successful refresh.
blocks: Pending: submitted details and neutral waiting explanation
Rejected: supplied feedback and correction link
Approved but unplaced: assignment pending and authorized contact
Inactive or suspended: permitted guidance and any narrow recovery link
pages.primary: Contextual action: Refresh status, Correct application or Open recovery, depending on returned permission.
pages.secondary: Sign out stays visible; help is below the status explanation.
pages.why: Sand is for waiting/action-needed explanation; approved identity alone does not get a green Ready for work badge. Status text carries meaning independently of color.
pages.special_states: Unknown review state is unresolved, not approved; unavailable status differs from a rejected application; do not promise a review turnaround without supplied evidence.
pages.dependency: Fresh approval/activity/placement capabilities; native resubmission is not enabled by this design.

pages.name: Restricted recovery overview
pages.purpose: Show only explicitly authorized held-work recovery.
pages.top: Restriction explanation and named receiving hub when authorized.
blocks: Allowed held parcels and cash responsibilities
pages.primary: Open authorized handover: lower action only when returned as available.
pages.secondary: Contact the approved receiving team; sign out does not surrender custody.
pages.why: A quiet sand panel explains the restriction; a neutral list limits visual claims to returned duties. No ordinary task navigation appears.
pages.special_states: Missing recovery capability shows contact guidance; suspended status never becomes a normal dashboard through a cached task.
pages.dependency: Accepted narrow recovery contract and authorized receiving data.

pages.name: Home / Tasks
pages.purpose: Find the next responsibility before statistics or decoration.
pages.top: Identity, assigned hub, duty switch and activity entry; heading Your tasks.
blocks: Available pickups / Active pickups / Delivery filters with returned counts
Prominent selected or continuing task: stage, stop, full parcel reference, exact cash when relevant
Small truthful daily activity only after operational work
pages.primary: Open Stop Mode on the prominent task; Claim pickup remains inside the available-task review.
pages.secondary: Search within this queue; filters open O02; duty change uses O01.
pages.why: One raised white current-task card gives hierarchy without outlining every row. Rose selection and dark text mark the active filter; secondary rows use spacing and subtle dividers.
pages.special_states: Off duty retains active work; missing assignment has placement guidance; empty queue differs from failed load; no map or fake totals in empty state.
pages.dependency: Scoped queue/capacity contract; selection is presentation and never optimization.

pages.name: Stop Mode
pages.purpose: Finish the current authorized stop from one focused working view.
pages.top: Back, current phase/stage, full tracking reference and Help.
blocks: Doorstep Guide excerpt with Open instructions
Exact COD or explicit prepaid/unavailable cash state
pages.primary: One stage-specific primary action in a sticky lower shelf above the navigation bar.
pages.secondary: Directions, Call and Message are neutral labelled controls beside the destination; Finder and guide links sit with their information.
pages.why: The primary shelf is red only for the permitted next action. Map and address form one group; instructions are borderless unless a warning needs a sand inset; selection never means custody.
pages.special_states: Eight stage variants are catalogued separately. Missing pin keeps address usable; stale permission removes the mutation; a lost response shows checking rather than success.
pages.dependency: Existing task/command acceptance, selected tag/instruction dependencies and optional map decision.

pages.name: Waybill scanner
pages.purpose: Read genuine parcel input and review the match before custody changes.
pages.top: Close or Back, expected parcel, accessible torch control.
blocks: Camera view with a bounded scan guide
pages.primary: Review match after a real read; never auto-confirm a custody transition.
pages.secondary: Torch is a 48-unit target; read-only code lookup uses O11 only if useful.
pages.why: Camera content has no decorative card; white/opaque control backplates preserve contrast. Match feedback includes text and icon, not only green.
pages.special_states: Denied camera offers device settings and permitted lookup; wrong, duplicate or unreadable code cannot produce a match; one pending read/review at a time.
pages.dependency: Camera adapter, physical-phone verification and accepted waybill evidence.

pages.name: Parcel Finder
pages.purpose: Locate the rider's parcel in a compartment or bag.
pages.top: Parcel Finder, current scope and clear organization-only explanation.
blocks: List of owned parcels with full reference and optional suffix emphasis
Small motorcycle/bag diagram with labelled slots
Selected parcel position and edit/clear actions
pages.primary: Set parcel location: opens O05 for the selected owned parcel.
pages.secondary: Find by tracking reference; return to Stop Mode; scan identity through P07.
pages.why: Rose highlights one selected slot; other slots have visible outlines and text labels. A diagram is a personal memory aid, so it has no verified/custody badge.
pages.special_states: Unset location stays explicit; refresh preserves authorized local tags; account change clears scoped private state; final-mile multi-parcel load is not implied.
pages.dependency: Selected tag model, session-only versus private persistence and cleanup decision; current multi-pickup capacity only.

pages.name: Doorstep Guide
pages.purpose: Understand the correct collection point or entrance before travel and handoff.
pages.top: Stop name, phase and the original destination.
pages.primary: Directions to the saved destination: lower neutral action; guide reading itself is not a mutation.
pages.secondary: Copy address; call verified phase contact; return to Stop Mode.
pages.why: Borderless text sections avoid treating each sentence as a button. Only a materially important access warning uses a tinted inset; the destination remains dark and prominent.
pages.special_states: No notes says No extra instructions provided; unknown fields do not become guessed landmarks; clarification cannot silently redirect a parcel.
pages.dependency: Authorized phase-specific instruction data and update ownership; text-first selection excludes an automatic photo or pin-report service.

pages.name: Expanded saved-stop map
pages.purpose: Explore the authorized saved stop without losing the address or task.
pages.top: Back, Saved stop label and parcel context.
blocks: Street map with one authorized destination pin
Labelled zoom and Show stop controls
pages.primary: Directions: neutral control in the lower address shelf; custody action remains in Stop Mode.
pages.secondary: Show stop, zoom, Copy address and Open instructions.
pages.why: One bounded 8-unit map frame contains visual complexity. Opaque controls protect contrast; a stationary pin means a saved destination, never live rider location.
pages.special_states: Missing coordinates use the address layout; tile error preserves text and manual retry; no predicted route line, ETA, geofence enforcement or offline bulk tiles.
pages.dependency: Embedded-map M09.07 decision and provider policy; expanded layout is conditional until the renderer/data are accepted.

pages.name: Delivery evidence
pages.purpose: Review recipient evidence and a genuine proof image.
pages.top: Parcel reference, step label and Back.
blocks: Photo source action and proof thumbnail with replace/remove
Optional note with limit and inline errors
pages.primary: Continue: full-width lower action after required evidence is ready.
pages.secondary: Replace/remove photo near the thumbnail; cancel via discard-draft O08.
pages.why: Fields have visible outlines; photo is grouped in one white surface. One red continuation avoids competing Capture, Retake and Submit colors.
pages.special_states: Camera/picker interruption recovers only the authorized draft; rejected upload keeps safe input; photo selection does not record delivery.
pages.dependency: Accepted evidence fields/limits, private media handling and real-device lifecycle verification.

pages.name: Cash collection review
pages.purpose: Make exact cash due understandable and check change before handoff.
pages.top: Parcel reference and Cash at delivery.
blocks: Payment method or clear no-COD state
Optional cash-tendered helper and read-only correct change
Acknowledgement required by the accepted outcome
pages.primary: Continue to review: lower red action only when the required cash evidence is valid.
pages.secondary: Cash problem opens O10; Back preserves permitted entered evidence.
pages.why: Amount due is dark and large; the card is not a colored earnings tile. Tender/change rows use grouping and a divider to keep calculation separate from recorded cash.
pages.special_states: Missing or invalid COD is unavailable, not zero; insufficient tender offers the allowed issue path; prepaid work skips unnecessary cash entry.
pages.dependency: Accepted exact-cash acknowledgement; helper does not replace the server amount or create remittance.

pages.name: Final handoff review
pages.purpose: Catch wrong parcel, evidence or cash before recording the outcome.
pages.top: Review handoff and full parcel identity.
blocks: Editable section links and clear outcome wording
pages.primary: Record delivery: one lower red submit; changes to Recording while pending.
pages.secondary: Edit evidence or cash next to that section; Cancel does not cancel assignment.
pages.why: One review surface keeps related facts together; dark labelled values support recognition. The only saturated action is the actual record submission.
pages.special_states: Double tap is blocked; validation returns to the affected step with safe drafts; uncertain response is S09 and must reconcile before retry.
pages.dependency: Accepted outcome/idempotency contract; this records DELIVERED rather than buyer completion.

pages.name: Recorded result receipt
pages.purpose: See what the server actually recorded and what responsibility remains.
pages.top: Outcome title, parcel and recorded time.
blocks: Buyer confirmation and cash duties shown separately
pages.primary: Next task or View record: neutral lower action; no second record button.
pages.secondary: Open related timeline; show remaining cash responsibility only when available.
pages.why: A small mint result inset with icon/text acknowledges confirmed evidence. The rest is white and readable; no confetti, countdown or implied payout.
pages.special_states: Only server-confirmed result opens this receipt; origin intake, return receipt and delivery are named variants rather than separate new routes.
pages.dependency: Recorded event and authorized proof/history data; receipt cannot grant a new transition.

pages.name: Failed-delivery form
pages.purpose: Record a permitted reason and understand the next responsibility.
pages.top: Could not deliver, parcel and current destination.
blocks: Permitted reason list with plain labels
Explicit reminder that failure does not end custody
pages.primary: Record failed attempt: lower red action after required fields.
pages.secondary: Back/Cancel preserves or discards through O08; approved help stays nearby.
pages.why: Reason fields and evidence boundaries are visible; sand communicates the return implication without using alarm red for every item.
pages.special_states: Unknown failure code is unsupported; denied/stale attempts refresh; recorded attempt count is server-owned; no rider-selected retry date.
pages.dependency: Accepted exception reasons/evidence, attempt record and hub-return contract.

pages.name: Attempt and return timeline
pages.purpose: Understand attempts, receipt and the hub's next decision.
pages.top: Parcel reference and Recorded attempts.
blocks: Approved retry decision or reverse-logistics instruction
Responsible actor for the current wait
pages.primary: Open current responsibility: neutral lower link to Stop Mode.
pages.secondary: Open authorized evidence or help; filters do not erase attempts.
pages.why: Timeline uses a quiet line and labelled status dots; the current instruction alone receives sand or rose emphasis. Past records remain neutral.
pages.special_states: Waiting is distinct from approved retry; third-failure/refusal reverse flow is not a rider Return completed button.
pages.dependency: Recorded exception history, fresh instruction and private evidence permissions.

pages.name: Restricted handover review
pages.purpose: Review a narrowly allowed parcel/cash recovery at the named receiver.
pages.top: Recovery handover, authorized parcel and receiving hub.
pages.primary: Submit permitted recovery evidence: lower action only when explicitly allowed.
pages.secondary: Contact receiver; exit through safe draft handling.
pages.why: Neutral evidence fields and a sand responsibility panel avoid presenting restored approval. Read-only assignment data is not styled as an editable control.
pages.special_states: Absent capability removes submission; recovery acceptance cannot unlock ordinary operations or self-confirm the receiver's custody.
pages.dependency: Narrow backend recovery action; complete receiver evidence remains a prerequisite.

pages.name: Trips
pages.purpose: Find returned records within their real scope and period.
pages.top: Trips, period and explicit returned history scope.
blocks: Day-grouped records with readable outcome and time
Pagination or Load more with explicit progress
pages.primary: Open a trip row: neutral chevron/text affordance; no arbitrary filled page-level action.
pages.secondary: Date range O17; clear filters; copy identifier.
pages.why: Borderless grouped rows and subtle separators suit reading many records. A current filter is rose; recorded result badges include text. No invented lifetime rates.
pages.special_states: No records differs from no matches and a failed page; unavailable pickup/previous-hub history stays disclosed.
pages.dependency: Scoped/paginated history contract; declared attribution and Philippine dates.

pages.name: Trip detail and journey
pages.purpose: Review recorded custody and the rider's contribution.
pages.top: Parcel, phase and recorded outcome.
pages.primary: View proof or Open current task when still authorized: neutral lower action.
pages.secondary: Copy tracking; expand timestamps and recorded details.
pages.why: Connected timeline groups the journey without a giant full-width map. White record sections are unboxed where headings/dividers suffice; selected context uses rose.
pages.special_states: Unavailable milestone has no fake timestamp; a past parcel cannot regain a live mutation; do not expose contacts after access ends.
pages.dependency: Recorded checkpoints/history and private proof access.

pages.name: Private proof viewer
pages.purpose: Inspect the permitted accepted proof without turning it into public content.
pages.top: Close/Back, parcel context and proof time when supplied.
pages.primary: Close: large reachable control; there is no download/share action by default.
pages.secondary: Zoom controls and return to record; gesture zoom is supplementary.
pages.why: Media can use a dark viewing stage with light readable controls; it is not the optional whole-app dark theme. Image bounds and controls are visually separate.
pages.special_states: Expired or denied access has a useful return path; no stale previous-account image; an accepted image is not editable here.
pages.dependency: Authorized private evidence, retention and cleanup policy.

pages.name: Conversations
pages.purpose: Find the correct parcel-linked person and thread.
pages.top: Messages, scoped conversation count and search.
blocks: Parcel reference and Pickup/Delivery phase label
Last message/time and actual unread count
pages.primary: Open conversation: row with clear name/phase; no New message to arbitrary users.
pages.secondary: Search by authorized contact/reference; refresh with feedback.
pages.why: Simple rows use separators rather than nested chat cards; rose marks selection and a small unread badge. Read state is actual data, not decorative dots.
pages.special_states: An empty list explains when threads appear; network failure does not mark all messages read; selection/drafts survive permitted refresh.
pages.dependency: Scoped conversations, phase-bound recipients and read acknowledgement.

pages.name: Conversation thread
pages.purpose: Coordinate this parcel without losing task context.
pages.top: Back to conversations, participant, parcel and phase.
blocks: Composer with persistent label, character limit and send error
pages.primary: Send message: labelled control beside or below composer; reachable above keyboard.
pages.secondary: Return to task; editable quick replies remain optional; retry read update is distinct from resending.
pages.why: Sent/received bubbles use neutral and light rose grouping; no saturated red wall of messages. Composer has a visible border and independently reachable Send.
pages.special_states: Switching thread preserves scoped drafts; stale recipient/phase cannot redirect a message; show new-message indicator without forcing scroll away from old content.
pages.dependency: Message/read APIs; only displayed selected messages are acknowledged. Composer layout covers root chrome temporarily in compact typing mode.

pages.name: Activity inbox
pages.purpose: Notice durable work, review and cash events missed during a session.
pages.top: Activity and actual unread scope.
blocks: Plain event title, parcel/subject and timestamp
Read/unread status paired with text or icon
pages.primary: Open event: neutral row action, not an unsupported bulk mark-all control.
pages.secondary: Individual read actions O14 when supported; refresh.
pages.why: Unboxed rows use grouping for chronology; rose emphasis is reserved for unread selection, and event kinds use modest semantic icons.
pages.special_states: Unknown/delayed event remains readable without guessing a route; failed read update does not claim success; unavailable notice API is S11.
pages.dependency: Backend durable notification resource and fresh own-resource authorization.

pages.name: Activity detail
pages.purpose: Read a notice and find the actual current action.
pages.top: Event title and supplied time.
blocks: Current availability of the linked resource
pages.primary: Open authorized destination: lower neutral or contextual primary only if real work is available.
pages.secondary: Back to Activity; Mark read only through the accepted own-event action.
pages.why: Most notices are neutral text; a sand or mint inset follows actual event meaning. An old event does not get a live-action badge merely because it was unread.
pages.special_states: Denied/removed target keeps a safe explanation; event history never overrides current authorization.
pages.dependency: Durable event details, accepted links and current capability.

pages.name: Profile
pages.purpose: Find identity, assignment and useful account actions.
pages.top: Actual avatar/initials, name and reviewed status; modest cover motif.
blocks: Company, hub and barangay with absent-value wording
Rows for Information, Assignment, Vehicle, Settings and Cash when available
pages.primary: Edit contact details: neutral labelled action after contact summary.
pages.secondary: Open managed records and settings; unsupported cash shows availability guidance rather than a wallet balance.
pages.why: A quiet cover adds identity without a credential/pass graphic. Rows are largely borderless with chevrons; review badge uses actual state and dark text.
pages.special_states: No default license, hours or hub; profile review and working eligibility stay separate; avatar editing is not added without a supported contract.
pages.dependency: Own identity/profile and managed placement resource.

pages.name: Edit contact information
pages.purpose: Save only permitted contact fields with clear validation.
pages.top: Edit information, Back and current field purpose.
blocks: Persistent labels and actual format guidance
Inline field errors and saved acknowledgement
pages.primary: Save contact details: full-width lower red action.
pages.secondary: Discard/back through O08 if changed; read-only reviewed identity fields link to guidance.
pages.why: Outlined inputs mean editable data; one white form surface groups the fields. Managed identity/placement is visually read-only rather than disabled-looking editable inputs.
pages.special_states: Rejected edits preserve safe text; duplicate save is blocked; fresh saved values replace drafts only after acceptance.
pages.dependency: Shared profile validators and permitted self-service fields.

pages.name: Assignment and hub directory
pages.purpose: Know where the rider works and how to reach the authorized hub.
pages.top: Company and assigned hub; area when configured.
pages.primary: Directions to this hub: lower neutral action with an actual destination.
pages.secondary: Call permitted hub contact; ask for correction through supported guidance.
pages.why: A white grouping surface separates assignment from operational work; fields have no input outlines because they cannot be edited here.
pages.special_states: Unassigned/missing address and contact are explicit; no guessed operating hours; absent barangay does not claim strict area-only coverage.
pages.dependency: Own managed placement and permitted hub-directory fields; new receiving instructions need agreement.

pages.name: Vehicle and credentials
pages.purpose: Read accurate managed vehicle/license information.
pages.top: Vehicle and credentials; logistics-managed explanation.
blocks: License and registration status from actual fields
Permitted private document link only if supplied
pages.primary: Contact responsible team: neutral guidance action when a real contact exists.
pages.secondary: Back to Profile; reveal only authorized private evidence.
pages.why: Definition rows and quiet dividers make read-only facts easy to scan. No fake verification seal, barcode, uniform license restrictions or decorative pass.
pages.special_states: Not provided is different from verified; expired or unknown state is plain text; no rider-owned fleet/credential editing.
pages.dependency: Managed vehicle data and field-level/private document permission.

pages.name: Settings
pages.purpose: Find supported preferences, security and help without a crowded menu.
pages.top: Settings and Back.
blocks: Sign out as a separated action
pages.primary: No general primary button; each setting row opens its named destination.
pages.secondary: Sign out uses O09; optional controls appear only after actual support exists.
pages.why: Borderless rows with group dividers avoid a box around every preference. Sign out is labelled and separated, not colored like destructive account closure.
pages.special_states: Unavailable options explain or stay absent; no no-op switches or developer/API configuration in the rider menu.
pages.dependency: Accepted account actions; optional preferences remain their own design scope.

pages.name: Privacy and security
pages.purpose: Understand verification and change the password safely.
pages.top: Privacy and security.
pages.primary: Change password: neutral row leading to the focused form.
pages.secondary: Verify email opens the supported first-party flow; sign out remains explicit.
pages.why: Status is a small labelled inset; rows and explanatory text remain neutral. There is no generic green Secure account promise or artificial security score.
pages.special_states: Unverified email shows the actual prerequisite; unsupported device-session lists are not invented; closure cannot abandon held parcels/cash.
pages.dependency: Email verification, password policy and controlled closure authority.

pages.name: Change password
pages.purpose: Change credentials without obscuring requirements or losing errors.
pages.top: Change password, Back and verified-email prerequisite.
pages.primary: Update password: lower red submit with pending feedback.
pages.secondary: Back/discard through O08; recovery via approved entry if necessary.
pages.why: Clear outlined fields and a single submit focus on the task; requirements are text, not a misleading strength gauge unsupported by policy.
pages.special_states: Field failure retains permitted state but success clears sensitive values; revocation/expiry follows the real session policy.
pages.dependency: Accepted password/session policy; actual length constraints from the server.

pages.name: Help center
pages.purpose: Find a useful next step for field and account problems.
pages.top: Help, search or clear topic grouping.
pages.primary: Open topic or Contact help: neutral rows; context can carry the active parcel.
pages.secondary: How Rider works is P46 if selected; permission guidance links P48.
pages.why: Readable category headings and rows are calmer than colored feature tiles. A current problem may use one sand instruction inset.
pages.special_states: No invented support hours, emergency service or response guarantee; offline known guidance stays distinct from unavailable live help.
pages.dependency: Approved help content/contact routes; static instructions must match current flow.

pages.name: Help guide
pages.purpose: Understand one task or recovery procedure in plain language.
pages.top: Guide title and Back.
blocks: Useful contact or related task link
pages.primary: Open relevant task or Contact help: neutral lower link if authorized.
pages.secondary: Related guide links below the steps.
pages.why: Unboxed reading content, aligned steps and one caution inset improve grouping. Decorative illustrations never resemble a real proof or credential.
pages.special_states: Guidance cannot enable unsupported actions; stale version wording is updated with the owning flow; no dense legal wall above steps.
pages.dependency: Reviewed help guidance and the actual capability of the linked task.

pages.name: Contact help with parcel context
pages.purpose: Prepare useful context and contact an actual authorized help channel.
pages.top: Help for this parcel or account.
blocks: Short problem summary for the rider to review
pages.primary: Open supported contact channel: lower labelled neutral action.
pages.secondary: Choose another owned parcel using O19; keep sensitive proof out of copied context.
pages.why: Read-only context is unboxed; any editable summary has a visible outline. No fake ticket number or claim that a safety agent is monitoring.
pages.special_states: No configured channel means guidance rather than a dead button; submitted reports are not implied by copying or opening contact.
pages.dependency: Real contacts/approved help path; ticketing or incident persistence is outside this baseline.

pages.name: Privacy notice
pages.purpose: Read the current provided data-handling notice.
pages.top: Privacy, document version/date when supplied.
pages.primary: No required accept button for reading an existing notice; Return is the main navigation.
pages.secondary: Copy/open an approved policy link if supported.
pages.why: Neutral reading canvas and headings support scanning; no decorative colored legal cards or hidden consent choices.
pages.special_states: Unavailable/version-missing content is honest; draft policy copy is not represented as approved legal guidance.
pages.dependency: Approved notice text; this design does not establish retention or legal commitments.

pages.name: About Rider
pages.purpose: Understand the app, supported version and how it fits the parcel flow.
pages.top: BagooPH Rider with a small original parcel motif.
blocks: Actual app version and release label
Update guidance only when an actual distribution link exists
pages.primary: Help: neutral lower link when needed; no forced decorative button.
pages.secondary: Read How Rider works if available.
pages.why: A modest identity moment is appropriate on a low-frequency reading page. White surface and dark text remain consistent with operational screens.
pages.special_states: Build/version is actual data; no fake uptime, network endpoint, debug settings or automatically available update button.
pages.dependency: Public app metadata and approved support/distribution information.

pages.name: Cash responsibility overview
pages.purpose: Separate cash held, received remittance, discrepancy and earnings.
pages.top: Cash responsibility and covered scope/period.
blocks: Confirmed earnings as a separate destination
pages.primary: View remittance instructions: lower neutral or contextual action when a real duty exists.
pages.secondary: Open receipts, discrepancies and explanation O16.
pages.why: Amounts are dark and labelled in white groups; no saturated Wallet balance tile. Sand marks an actual unresolved responsibility, mint an actual receipt.
pages.special_states: No ledger support means Unavailable, not zero; missing amount/period stays explicit; delivery itself does not remit money.
pages.dependency: Accepted append-only finance resource and matching rider/hub/admin records.

pages.name: Remittance instructions
pages.purpose: Know the actual receiving point and required handover evidence.
pages.top: Remit cash, supplied amount and receiving hub.
blocks: Exact outstanding amount from the ledger
pages.primary: Open receiving directions or permitted remittance action: labelled lower action only if accepted.
pages.secondary: Contact receiver; view prior receipt.
pages.why: One responsibility group uses white or sand; read-only amounts have no input appearance. A rider acknowledgement is never styled as Hub received.
pages.special_states: Unavailable receiver/action has a reason; no arbitrary top-up or transfer method; uncertain submission reconciles before retry.
pages.dependency: Approved remittance contract and receiver evidence; no guessed payment channel.

pages.name: Remittance receipt
pages.purpose: Inspect a hub-confirmed cash receipt and its separate reconciliation state.
pages.top: Receipt reference, recorded receiver and time.
blocks: Reconciliation state and any remaining difference
pages.primary: Back to cash responsibility: neutral lower action.
pages.secondary: Open discrepancy or related record if authorized.
pages.why: A small mint received inset is separate from neutral reconciliation rows; green receipt does not mean seller paid.
pages.special_states: Pending reconciliation remains pending; missing signature/reference is not fabricated; no editable receipt or false downloadable statement.
pages.dependency: Hub-confirmed receipt resource and scoped finance evidence.

pages.name: Cash discrepancy detail
pages.purpose: Understand the recorded difference and the authorized resolution path.
pages.top: Recorded discrepancy and related parcel/receipt.
blocks: Expected versus received amounts from records
pages.primary: Open approved review/contact path: lower neutral action.
pages.secondary: Back to receipt or cash responsibility.
pages.why: Dark numeric labels and a sand reason inset give clarity without implying blame. Timeline rows show recorded corrections rather than editable balances.
pages.special_states: Unknown resolution stays unknown; no frontend edit of ledger history or manufactured reconciled amount.
pages.dependency: Accepted discrepancy/correction resource and owning review authority.

pages.name: Confirmed earnings
pages.purpose: See only approved rider earnings for the returned period.
pages.top: Confirmed earnings and actual period.
blocks: Date filter only where data supports it
pages.primary: Open earning record: neutral row action; no Withdraw button.
pages.secondary: Date range O17; cash responsibilities remain a separate link.
pages.why: Neutral totals and restrained bars support reading; a small accent can select the period. Earnings are not shown as COD cash or guessed fixed-rate totals.
pages.special_states: Missing earning policy/resource is unavailable; absent history is not lifetime zero; no estimated amount labelled paid.
pages.dependency: Confirmed final-mile attribution and accepted earning records; withdrawal is excluded.

pages.name: Earning record detail
pages.purpose: Understand the recorded source of one earning amount.
pages.top: Recorded earning amount and parcel/event.
pages.primary: Open related trip: neutral lower link.
pages.secondary: Return to earnings; copy the reference if supported.
pages.why: Definition rows with aligned currency values use quiet dividers; no decorative green payout seal or unrelated product commission breakdown.
pages.special_states: Unknown component/rate is not inferred; adjustments keep their actual source and state.
pages.dependency: Accepted per-record earning fields and private ownership scope.

pages.name: Comfort preferences
pages.purpose: Choose only supported local comfort options and see a real preview.
pages.top: Preferences with a live readable sample.
blocks: System text-size guidance or implemented app preference
Language/theme entries only after those features exist
Optional motion/haptic control only if implemented
pages.primary: No generic Save unless changes require it; each preference must visibly work.
pages.secondary: Open language/appearance; restore device defaults only if supported.
pages.why: Borderless rows and a neutral preview avoid a collection of nonfunctional switches. The preview demonstrates consequences before choice.
pages.special_states: Unsupported controls are absent or clearly explained; preferences cannot affect permission, assignment or duty.
pages.dependency: Optional preference implementation and real persistence/accessibility verification.

pages.name: Language preference
pages.purpose: Choose among actually completed translations.
pages.top: Language with current selection.
blocks: Supported language names in their own language
Effect on interface text, not operational codes
pages.primary: Apply language: lower red action only when a change exists.
pages.secondary: Cancel keeps the current language.
pages.why: A rose selected row plus radio/text makes selection visible; other options are neutral, readable and large.
pages.special_states: No option for an incomplete translation; long labels and pluralization are checked; no silent translation of server failure codes.
pages.dependency: Optional complete translation/content QA; English/Filipino are candidates, not implemented claims.

pages.name: Appearance preference
pages.purpose: Preview and select only implemented appearance choices.
pages.top: Appearance and small actual screen sample.
pages.primary: Apply appearance: lower red action for a real change.
pages.secondary: Cancel preserves the current appearance.
pages.why: The sample explains background/text/control changes; selection uses a radio and rose marker rather than relying on a color swatch alone.
pages.special_states: Dark appearance is a proposal until every component/state is checked; no instant appearance claim from a lone toggle.
pages.dependency: Optional complete palette/component implementation and contrast verification.

pages.name: How Rider works tour
pages.purpose: Learn the two work phases and how the selected tools help.
pages.top: How Rider works, step indicator and Skip.
blocks: Parcel Finder and Doorstep Guide explanation
pages.primary: Next / Finish: lower reachable red action.
pages.secondary: Skip and Close are labelled; never gate work behind a decorative tour.
pages.why: Simple vector motifs and quiet pages suit introductory learning; no pretend interactive scanner or completion event.
pages.special_states: Tour remains revisitable; skipping never changes approval; permissions are requested during the actual task rather than all at onboarding.
pages.dependency: Optional static tour selection; no native onboarding/API claim.

pages.name: Account closure guidance
pages.purpose: Explain the controlled path when a rider wants to close the account.
pages.top: Account closure and responsibility explanation.
blocks: Supported contact path and retained-record explanation from policy
pages.primary: Contact authorized management: neutral lower action if a real route exists.
pages.secondary: Return to security; sign out remains separate.
pages.why: A restrained warning inset explains consequences; no red Delete account button when a guarded request contract is unavailable.
pages.special_states: No client-only closure, role conversion or silent abandonment of custody; policy wording is supplied rather than invented.
pages.dependency: Controlled closure/help policy; self-service deletion is not baseline functionality.

pages.name: Device access and permissions
pages.purpose: Understand actual camera/media/navigation access and how to recover denial.
pages.top: Device access with accurate permission states.
blocks: Camera permission and the tasks that need it
Media access/picker guidance by device behavior
Location row only if an included feature actually needs it
pages.primary: Open device settings or Retry camera: lower labelled neutral action appropriate to the state.
pages.secondary: Return to the originating scan/proof task.
pages.why: Permission rows have status text/icons and no fake app-owned OS toggles. Neutral surfaces distinguish information from a real permission request.
pages.special_states: Denied/permanently denied/restricted are distinct; OS settings return refetches status; saved-stop navigation does not automatically require live GPS.
pages.dependency: Actual native permission/launcher adapters and real-device checks.

external_views.name: Application: rider information
external_views.purpose: Enter real registration/contact and operating-area fields.
blocks: Name, birthday with current age policy
Address and operating-area selectors as supported
external_views.primary: Continue to vehicle: after the form.
external_views.secondary: Back to sign in; inline help near the field.
external_views.why: One red continuation and outlined fields clarify the sequence; the stepper is navigation context rather than verification.
external_views.special_states: Field errors focus the first issue and preserve safe data; birth date cannot be replaced by a self-declared adult checkbox.
external_views.dependency: Existing first-party web flow; native equivalent needs separate API scope.

external_views.name: Application: vehicle information
external_views.purpose: Provide the vehicle/license identifiers required by the current application.
blocks: Plate or registration reference according to policy
external_views.why: Vehicle choices are labelled radio/cards with real selected state; quiet forms avoid turning every type into a saturated tile.
external_views.special_states: Actual permitted type/identifier rules apply; no guessed licensed status.
external_views.dependency: Existing first-party web flow; native equivalent needs separate API scope.

external_views.name: Application: documents and password
external_views.purpose: Review required private documents and credentials before submission.
blocks: Identity/license/registration uploads with preview and replace/remove
external_views.primary: Submit application: after requirements and review.
external_views.secondary: Back, replace/remove and recovery help are secondary.
external_views.why: Upload regions have discoverable borders; one red submit contrasts with neutral source controls. Upload selection is not approval.
external_views.special_states: Interrupted/rejected uploads retain only safe allowed drafts; password values follow secure cleanup.
external_views.dependency: Existing first-party web flow; native equivalent needs separate API scope.

external_views.name: Email-code verification panel
external_views.purpose: Complete the existing registration or recovery email challenge.
external_views.top: Verify email and masked supplied address.
blocks: One accessible code input supporting full paste/autofill
external_views.secondary: Resend is a labelled secondary action only when allowed.
external_views.why: Visible input boundary and one primary reduce attention switching; no mandatory six tiny independent boxes or cognitive puzzle.
external_views.special_states: Wrong/expired code is recoverable; retry limits and timers come from the real flow, never a fake countdown.
external_views.dependency: Existing first-party web flow; native equivalent needs separate API scope.

external_views.name: Application correction and resubmission
external_views.purpose: Respond to reviewer feedback in the current web flow.
blocks: Reviewed details that cannot be silently overwritten
external_views.primary: Submit correction for review: lower action when allowed.
external_views.secondary: Refresh status and sign out remain distinct.
external_views.why: Sand highlights actionable feedback; fields alone have control borders. No green operational badge while placement/review is missing.
external_views.special_states: Feedback is actual; a completed decision cannot be changed through an unsupported field.
external_views.dependency: Existing first-party web flow; native equivalent needs separate API scope.

external_views.name: Password recovery request
external_views.purpose: Start the supported recovery channel for the registered account.
blocks: Email-code or reset-link option supported by the current flow
external_views.primary: Continue with supported recovery: after email.
external_views.secondary: Back to Rider sign in; alternate supported recovery path.
external_views.why: A simple neutral form avoids decorative distractions; one red continuation makes the action legible.
external_views.special_states: Autofill/paste work; failed delivery of recovery mail is not shown as sent; no unsupported phone/SMS login.
external_views.dependency: Existing first-party web flow; native equivalent needs separate API scope.

external_views.name: Recovery: new password
external_views.purpose: Set the password after the real verified challenge or reset link.
external_views.top: New password and verified recovery context.
external_views.secondary: Back to recovery; success returns to sign in rather than silently creating a native session.
external_views.why: Outlined inputs and plain requirements prioritize the task; no made-up password strength or token details in user copy.
external_views.special_states: Expired challenge returns to recovery; success clears secrets; the native app refetches a fresh session after sign-in.
external_views.dependency: Existing first-party web flow; native equivalent needs separate API scope.

external_views.name: Email verification outcome
external_views.purpose: Read the actual email verification result and return to refresh the account.
blocks: Verified, expired or rejected link result
external_views.primary: Return and refresh verification: supported continuation.
external_views.secondary: Resend only when available; recovery/help remains secondary.
external_views.why: A small confirmed mint state is used only after acceptance; errors use labelled dark error text on a pale inset.
external_views.special_states: Expired link does not become verified; a web result does not automatically transfer browser authentication.
external_views.dependency: Existing first-party web flow; native equivalent needs separate API scope.

overlays.name: Go off duty
overlays.content: Explain no new work while existing responsibilities remain; Keep working and Go off duty are explicit.
overlays.treatment: Red only on the chosen confirmation; no destructive account wording.
overlays.recovery: Pending, rejection and uncertain result keep original duty until confirmed.

overlays.name: Queue/history filters
overlays.content: Show applicable phase/date/payment filters, Apply and Clear with current selection.
overlays.treatment: Neutral outlined choices; rose radio selection; lower Apply reachable.
overlays.recovery: Cancel restores prior filters; count/result is updated only by the real query.

overlays.name: Pickup claim review
overlays.content: Review ready parcel, seller, origin hub and returned eligibility before Claim pickup.
overlays.treatment: One red claim; critical facts are neutral; claimed is not collected.
overlays.recovery: Competing claim/stale capacity retains a useful refresh path.

overlays.name: Scan match review
overlays.content: Compare actually read and expected full references, then invoke the permitted confirmation.
overlays.treatment: Text and icon accompany a match; wrong code has labelled error.
overlays.recovery: No automatic stored-code confirmation; duplicate/rejected read keeps custody unchanged.

overlays.name: Choose parcel compartment
overlays.content: Pick a labelled bag/compartment; Save location or Clear for this parcel only.
overlays.treatment: Rose selection plus radio/text and outlined 48-unit targets.
overlays.recovery: Tag save does not prove a scan, physical load or server custody.

overlays.name: Proof source choice
overlays.content: Offer only supported camera/picker sources with accessible names.
overlays.treatment: Neutral choice rows; no second red submit competes with evidence review.
overlays.recovery: Unavailable camera shows a supported recovery path, not a fabricated image.

overlays.name: Replace or remove proof
overlays.content: Preview local selected proof and Replace/Remove before outcome acceptance.
overlays.treatment: Neutral replace; labelled removal; clear local-only meaning.
overlays.recovery: Accepted immutable proof is viewed in P20 rather than edited here.

overlays.name: Discard unsaved draft
overlays.content: Keep editing is easy to reach; Discard identifies exactly which local draft is lost.
overlays.treatment: Separated destructive wording; do not color Cancel as the primary outcome.
overlays.recovery: Dismiss preserves input; discarding does not cancel assignment.

overlays.name: Sign out
overlays.content: Explain local session exit and safe draft cleanup without surrendering held work.
overlays.treatment: Neutral Cancel and explicit Sign out; no closure wording.
overlays.recovery: Server revocation failure and local cleanup result are distinct.

overlays.name: Cash problem guidance
overlays.content: Explain missing amount/insufficient tender/change and open the permitted exception path.
overlays.treatment: Sand guidance with dark amount text; no local override to amount due.
overlays.recovery: Only supported failure codes and actual evidence can record an outcome.

overlays.name: Read-only code lookup
overlays.content: Enter/copy a reference to locate owned context when scanning cannot read.
overlays.treatment: Visible text field and neutral Look up; clearly not scan evidence.
overlays.recovery: Lookup never substitutes for a required genuine matching scan or bypasses camera/evidence policy.

overlays.name: Call a permitted contact
overlays.content: Show the valid phase contact and let the device dial through explicit action.
overlays.treatment: Neutral labelled Call control, full target and safe dismissal.
overlays.recovery: Missing phone removes the action; no invented masking/recording service.

overlays.name: Open navigation
overlays.content: Review saved destination and choose an installed supported navigation app.
overlays.treatment: Opaque white sheet over map; neutral choices and readable address.
overlays.recovery: Launch failure retains copy/address; no default city or location tracking claim.

overlays.name: Activity item actions
overlays.content: Open or mark an own event read only where accepted; keep actions contextual.
overlays.treatment: Quiet action rows, labelled selection, no bulk fake success.
overlays.recovery: Unknown target/read rejection stays readable and does not acknowledge unrelated events.

overlays.name: Read-status explanation
overlays.content: Explain this thread's displayed acknowledgement and allow a failed read update retry.
overlays.treatment: Neutral explanatory surface; no message-resend button mixed into read retry.
overlays.recovery: Opening the inbox never marks every thread read.

overlays.name: Cash and earnings meaning
overlays.content: Explain held, hub-received, reconciled and earned with the returned scope.
overlays.treatment: Neutral labels and small semantic chips; no wallet/withdraw promise.
overlays.recovery: Unknown finance capability is explicit; no guessed balances.

overlays.name: Date-range selection
overlays.content: Choose a supported Philippine-date period with Apply/Clear.
overlays.treatment: Readable outlined date controls; rose selected range, one primary Apply.
overlays.recovery: Invalid range is inline; unsupported historical scope is not silently expanded.

overlays.name: Email verification guidance
overlays.content: Explain the real prerequisite and launch the approved first-party verification path.
overlays.treatment: Neutral information with an explicit continuation, not a fake local verify toggle.
overlays.recovery: Return refetches actual status; absent verification action is unavailable.

overlays.name: Choose help parcel context
overlays.content: Choose only returned owned work or Account issue before contacting help.
overlays.treatment: Quiet parcel rows with clear selected radio and reference.
overlays.recovery: Foreign/expired assignment is excluded; no copying private proof or customer details by default.

overlays.name: Why this action is unavailable
overlays.content: Explain current missing permission, data, placement or prerequisite and give a real recovery action.
overlays.treatment: Readable neutral/sand message, no decorative disabled-state tooltip requiring hover.
overlays.recovery: Do not infer a reason from an empty list or promise that a retry will approve the account.

system_surfaces.name: Device camera permission
system_surfaces.purpose: System-owned permission request after a contextual explanation; the app cannot recolor or fake its approval.

system_surfaces.name: Device camera / media picker
system_surfaces.purpose: System-owned capture/selection surface; preserve the app's parcel context and recover cancellation/interruption.

system_surfaces.name: Device navigation-app chooser
system_surfaces.purpose: Installed app choice/launch result; native look is device-owned and not an app design page.

states.name: Loading
states.behavior: Show a finite progress description or skeleton for the requested region; retain safe context without sample work.

states.name: Returned empty / no matches
states.behavior: Use a small quiet parcel motif and an actual next step; distinguish empty scope from a filter with no results.

states.name: Read failed
states.behavior: Keep page identity and Retry; do not replace unknown counts with zero or erase authorized drafts.

states.name: Refreshing / stale
states.behavior: Show last successful refresh when known; selection stays bound to the parcel and mutations recheck fresh permission.

states.name: Connection unavailable
states.behavior: Keep allowed text/drafts, show recovery and honest unavailable submission; do not promise offline custody.

states.name: Submitting
states.behavior: Name the action in progress, block repeated taps, keep the parcel visible and explain permitted cancellation.

states.name: Validation rejected
states.behavior: Inline field errors plus announced summary, focus/scroll to first issue, preserve only safe permitted inputs.

states.name: Denied / stale assignment
states.behavior: Show the server reason safely and refresh/return; never locally replay an action on another parcel.

states.name: Result unconfirmed
states.behavior: Show Checking whether this was recorded and an accepted reconciliation path before a same-intent retry.

states.name: Confirmed result
states.behavior: Use specific recorded outcome, time/reference when supplied and useful next step; no inferred buyer completion/payout.

states.name: Capability or data unavailable
states.behavior: Explain what is unavailable; hide unsupported actions or give a focusable reason; never invent values or no-op preferences.

states.name: Permission unavailable
states.behavior: Differentiate denied/restricted/permanently denied using actual device state; offer supported settings or permitted fallback.

states.name: Session ended / account changed
states.behavior: Return to sign-in or holding and clear previous-account private state; sign-out does not remove custody responsibilities.

states.name: Read-only / completed phase
states.behavior: Keep authorized history readable; disable sending/editing with a reason; an old record cannot gain live authority.

states.name: Compatibility / unknown status
states.behavior: Use safe holding guidance, actual supported help/update links and fresh check; no guessing a new status or endpoint.

stop_variants.name: Available pickup
stop_variants.truth: Preview, not custody; claim eligibility is fresh.

stop_variants.name: Claimed pickup
stop_variants.truth: Claim created responsibility; seller handoff is still required.

stop_variants.name: Collected pickup
stop_variants.truth: Hub records receipt; rider cannot self-confirm origin intake.

stop_variants.name: Assigned final-mile
stop_variants.truth: Hub assignment precedes physical departure; no self-claim of other parcels.

stop_variants.name: Out for delivery
stop_variants.truth: Exact COD, doorstep notes and genuine evidence; no buyer completion.

stop_variants.name: Delivery recorded
stop_variants.truth: Buyer confirmation and cash remittance remain separate.

stop_variants.name: Failed delivery / return
stop_variants.truth: Held parcel remains visible until hub-owned return acceptance.

stop_variants.name: Restricted recovery
stop_variants.truth: Narrow capability only; this is not ordinary portal access.

coverage.reason: Visible values/actions depend on agreed resources; no field/API is inferred from a drawing.
Shared shell, fields, safe areas, focus and recoverable modal patterns.
Entry, holding, existing web onboarding/recovery and logout.
Own work overview, task detail, selection and chosen organization extension.
Duty and working eligibility without hiding existing custody.
Claimed seller pickup to origin-hub receipt, including real scan review.
Assigned hub departure, recipient/evidence/cash review and confirmed outcome.
Failure, return responsibility and limited recovery.
Phase-correct address, selected instruction extension, map and contact fallback.
Conversation/list, context, composer, read and stale-phase behavior.
Recorded results, history, timeline, scoped proof and filters.
Durable notice list/details and own read actions.
Own identity, permitted contact edits and managed placement/vehicle facts.
Settings, security/help/notice/about, device access and explicitly optional pages.
Exact cash, remittance, discrepancy, reconciliation and confirmed earnings.
Every page inherits error/access/lifecycle, keyboard, accessibility and device checks.

future_concepts.name: Shift readiness
future_concepts.purpose: Review actual device readiness and simple rider self-checks before new work.
future_concepts.layout: Hub/duty context, actual camera/connectivity result, cash-change reminder if relevant; lower Continue and Not now.
future_concepts.why: Neutral checklist with one rose selected state; no fake verified equipment or arbitrary mandatory checkboxes.
future_concepts.dependency: Optional readiness logic and actual device signals; not selected for implementation.

future_concepts.name: Shift closeout
future_concepts.purpose: See held parcels, pending returns and cash responsibility together after going off duty.
future_concepts.layout: Real period at top, outstanding duties before delivered summary; lower Open next responsibility, with receipts linked in their group.
future_concepts.why: Sand only on unresolved duties; quiet confirmed records. Closing a shift cannot hide custody or imply all cash was received.
future_concepts.dependency: Scoped shift data and accepted finance/return resources; not a required duty-blocking gate.

future_concepts.name: Wrong-pin or entrance report
future_concepts.purpose: Report a navigation problem while retaining the original saved destination.
future_concepts.layout: Original address, permitted issue choice and short note; lower Submit report and Cancel; map correction preview only if accepted.
future_concepts.why: Outlined evidence fields and one red Submit; submitted feedback is not an approved destination change.
future_concepts.dependency: Accepted report persistence, review ownership and safe destination policy.

future_concepts.name: Arrival estimate and route plan
future_concepts.purpose: Read supported travel estimates and an approved multi-stop sequence.
future_concepts.layout: Estimate range and freshness, route/map/list explanation, accessible stop list and lower Open next stop.
future_concepts.why: Neutral estimate labels distinguish forecast from promise; rose marks current selection; maps never simulate optimized results.
future_concepts.dependency: Accepted routing/ETA data, freshness, permission and dispatch policy; current single final-mile capacity remains unchanged.

future_concepts.name: Batch load checklist
future_concepts.purpose: Compare physically read parcel codes with an accepted manifest before departure.
future_concepts.layout: Expected and verified counts, owned parcel list, missing/unexpected discrepancy groups and lower Review load.
future_concepts.why: Text/icon match states and one actionable discrepancy group; scan review precedes any authorized departure.
future_concepts.dependency: Accepted batch/manifest/capacity contract and real scan evidence; several final-mile parcels are not currently assignable as a run.

future_concepts.name: Same-stop parcel group
future_concepts.purpose: Show compatible parcels at one verified collection/delivery stop.
future_concepts.layout: Stop heading and parcel checklist inside Stop Mode; each identifier, cash amount and outcome remains separately visible.
future_concepts.why: A shared region expresses common destination without a bulk Delivered button; grouping must not merge responsibilities.
future_concepts.dependency: Verified compatible grouping; final-mile grouping needs separate capacity/assignment acceptance.

future_concepts.name: Queue changed review
future_concepts.purpose: Explain additions, removals or server-directed changes after refresh.
future_concepts.layout: Short change summary, affected parcel references, preserved authorized selection and lower Return to current task.
future_concepts.why: Quiet delta rows and one selected context prevent surprise; no locally optimized reorder is implied.
future_concepts.dependency: Reliable comparison of fresh authorized task resources; removed private context is cleared.

future_concepts.name: Recipient PIN verification
future_concepts.purpose: Verify a recipient only if the accepted handoff model requires a real PIN.
future_concepts.layout: Parcel/recipient context, one accessible paste-capable code field, actual expiry/retry feedback and lower Verify.
future_concepts.why: Clear input boundary and single action reduce precision effort; PIN verification does not equal buyer completion.
future_concepts.dependency: Backend identity/PIN issuance, verification and failure contract; decorative PIN input is excluded.

future_concepts.name: Shift statement preview
future_concepts.purpose: Review a permitted dated summary before export.
future_concepts.layout: Scope/period and actual trips, returns and receipts; redact unnecessary contacts; lower Export with format disclosure.
future_concepts.why: Neutral document rows and dark amounts encourage verification before sharing; no fabricated payout statement.
future_concepts.dependency: Accepted export data/privacy scope and actual file generation; not selected.

future_concepts.name: Editable quick replies
future_concepts.purpose: Insert a phase-appropriate draft for the rider to review before sending.
future_concepts.layout: Short labelled choices near the composer that insert text, then the existing Send action.
future_concepts.why: Neutral compact chips avoid automatic messages and rival primary buttons; complete instruction remains visible for review.
future_concepts.dependency: Optional template/content selection; existing recipient/phase authorization stays in force.

future_concepts.name: Incident report
future_concepts.purpose: Report an incident through a real approved channel if that service is added.
future_concepts.layout: Actual channel/availability, parcel context, permitted issue/evidence, lower Submit or Contact; safety help is clearly labelled.
future_concepts.why: Readable evidence and truthful response state; no invented live monitoring, emergency number or round-the-clock support.
future_concepts.dependency: Region-appropriate verified contacts and accepted reporting/support operation.

future_concepts.name: Consented location sharing
future_concepts.purpose: Understand and control location sharing only for an accepted feature.
future_concepts.layout: Who receives location and when, actual permission/share status, explicit Start/Stop and freshness; address still works independently.
future_concepts.why: Control and disclosure precede any moving dot; a permission or toggle is not proof of a live connection.
future_concepts.dependency: Explicit location/service/privacy/battery lifecycle scope; no background tracking in the baseline.
